parts.text: Now let me run the regional performance query. I need to join orders, customer, nation, and region tables to get revenue by region.

queries.query:
SELECT 
    r.r_name AS region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers,
    SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT YEAR(o.o_orderdate)) AS years_active
FROM region r
JOIN nation n ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
GROUP BY r.r_name, r.r_regionkey
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

    JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey

SELECT

    total_revenue,
    ROUND(total_revenue * 100.0 / SUM(total_revenue) OVER(), 1) AS revenue_pct

WITH quarterly_revenue AS (

        p.p_brand,
